name: Masters and Contracts
source:
"A small town girl falls into the world of four, wealthy men."

You're an aspiring musician who moves to the glittering capital from a small village, chasing your dreams of becoming a renowned composer.

By day, you're a waitress and by night, you're a pianist at a fashionable restaurant in the city.  

One fateful night, four of the city's most eligible and wealthiest bachelors decide to have an impromptu dinner at your workplace...

AND THEY WANT YOU.

[u]You're offered the opportunity of a lifetime, but only if you agree to enter into an iron-clad, contractual relationship with them.[/u] 

Once you're in, there's no way out. 

Do you have what it takes to hold your own against these Masters and their Contracts...?

[From [url=https://idenvi-official.itch.io/mastersandcontracts]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“一个小镇女孩陷入了四个富有男人的世界。”

你是一位有抱负的音乐家，从一个小村庄搬到了闪闪发光的首都，追逐成为著名作曲家的梦想。

白天，你是一名女服务员，晚上，你是城里一家时尚餐厅的钢琴师。

在一个命运攸关的夜晚，四位城里最有资格、最富有的单身汉决定在你的工作场所享用一顿即兴晚餐……

他们想要你。

[u]你将获得千载难逢的机会，但前提是你同意与他们建立铁定的合同关系。[/u] 

一旦进去就没有退路了。

你有能力对抗这些大师和他们的契约吗……？

[来自[url=https://idenvi-official.itch.io/mastersandcontracts]Itch.io[/url]]
